title: Are the Seven Wonders of the World Official? The Ancient List vs the 2007 New7Wonders
seoTitle: Are the 7 Wonders of the World Official? The Truth
seoDescription: No list of the Seven Wonders is official. Who made the ancient list, how the 2007 New7Wonders vote worked, and why UNESCO distanced itself from it.
excerpt: There is no official list of the Seven Wonders of the World. Here is who really made the ancient list (not Herodotus), where each wonder stood, how the 2007 New Seven Wonders vote that picked the Taj Mahal worked, and why UNESCO kept its distance.
